description: This file defines the WebResponse class and related enums and nested classes for handling HTTP/WebSocket responses within the Thunder Web namespace. It includes response status codes, serialization/deserialization mechanisms, and response properties.

classes.name: Web::Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/WebSocket response with serialization, deserialization, and property management functionalities.

classes.name: Web::Response::Serializer
classes.description: Handles serialization of Web::Response objects into streams.

classes.name: Web::Response::Deserializer
classes.description: Handles deserialization of streams into Web::Response objects.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Serializes a Web::Response object into a string.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a Web::Response object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the response has a valid error code.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the response properties to default values.

methods.name: Body
methods.description: Sets or gets the body of the response.

methods.name: Mode
methods.description: Sets or gets the serialization mode.
